rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for people or things being separate in space or for considering them separately.

example.english: The two tables need to be kept apart.
example.jyutping: loeng5 zoeng1 toi2 jiu3 fan1 hoi1 baai2

rows.note: Use this resultative pattern when V means taking something into separate pieces, as in 拆開.

example.english: Take the paper box apart and see if there is anything inside.
example.traditional: 將個紙盒拆開睇吓入面有冇嘢。
example.jyutping: zoeng3 go3 zi2 hap6 caak3 hoi1 tai2 haa5 jap6 min6 jau5 mou5 je5

rows.note: Use this when each person or thing does something separately rather than together.

example.english: You two can go home separately and stay apart.
example.traditional: 你哋各自搭車返屋企啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 dei6 gok3 zi6 daap3 ce1 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa1

rows.note: Use this when something is put or moved aside, physically or figuratively.

example.english: Put the clutter to one side and keep it apart until I’m done.
example.traditional: 你將啲雜物擺埋一邊，等我做完先。
example.jyutping: nei5 zoeng1 di1 zaap6 mat6 baai2 maai4 jat1 bin1 dang2 ngo5 zou6 jyun4 sin1
